record.limits_note: PI status is the binding constraint and is 'limited to faculty and research staff at US-based academic institutions'. International PIs are supported only as 'a limited number ... with ongoing, active collaborations with scientists in the US'. Students explicitly excluded except NSF GRFP holders. Accounts deactivate after 120 days' inactivity. FPGA resources additionally refuse residents or citizens of Iran, Iraq, North Korea, Sudan, Syria.
record.reliability_note: Project expiry immediately revokes all access and the allocation; storage is not offered as a durable service.
